boundaries.clientAttribution: The operator submitted the five-case prompt in ChatGPT mode and pasted the structured result into the closing Codex task in the same unified desktop application.
boundaries.telemetryScope: Server telemetry independently corroborates the tool order, one client principal, HTTP success, and snapshot identity. It does not retain tool arguments or structured response bodies, so those fields remain operator-supplied client evidence.
boundaries.typedNotFound: SOURCE_NOT_FOUND is a successful HTTP transport carrying a typed application-level not_found result.
boundaries.authentication: Bearer-token handling was not tested by this manual connection.
boundaries.remoteDeployment: TLS ingress, trusted-proxy handling, deployed authorization, accepted-main publication, hosting, availability, and rollback remain unmeasured and are outside MCP-001.
boundaries.theoryAuthority: Retrieval conformance does not promote or validate any theory claim.
